note:
Mint — RL/Iron. Board: 1.015 OK on 1 graded comp (PA MiKa), which pairs her with prika and therefore runs mode 'duet (w/ Prika)'. Kit-faithfulness is pinned test-first in scripts/tests/units/mint.test.ts, green vs shipped and red vs every named counterfactual (full-uptime S1, full-value S2, halved-burst, reversed parity, toggle-removed).
THE ASSIGNED-PART TOGGLE. Each of Mint's OWN burst casts flips her Assigned Part between Dancing and Singing — Dancing on cast 1, then Singing, Dancing, Singing, in strict alternation (owner-confirmed parity). It is modeled with a `singing` resource (0 = Dancing, 1 = Singing, declared in `resources`, initial 0) driven by two mode:'solo' blocks on her own burstCast: everyN 2 / everyNOffset 1 → delta −1 on her odd casts, everyN 2 / everyNOffset 0 → delta +1 on her even casts. Her Singing-gated lines then carry resourceGate {singing min 1} at FULL kit-literal magnitude and are live only on Singing rotations — S1 Singing Effect casterAtkPct 45.02, and S2 (enter Burst Stage 3 while Singing) critRatePct 19.94 / projectileExplosionPct 50 / pierceDamagePct 32.72. Full value on alternate rotations, NOT half value on every rotation; those differ whenever teammate damage is not spread evenly across her windows.
THE BURST'S SING ALONG BUFFS ARE UNCONDITIONAL — attackDamagePct 30.02, maxAmmoPct 40, critDamagePct 45.05, 10s, every rotation in every mode. They are deliberately outside the toggle; the kit does not gate them on an Assigned Part.
DANCING is a heal and nothing else: an event-only heal (ticks 3, intervalSec 1) per full-charge pull, resourceGate {singing max 0}, solo mode. There is no HP pool, so it moves damage ONLY through a Crown-style on-recovery consumer; in a consumer-less comp a Dancing rotation still contributes nothing. The HP magnitude (1.8% of her final Max HP) has no engine consumer and is recorded as unmodeled.
MODES. 'solo' is the graded DEFAULT (owner ruling) and matches her un-augmented kit behaviour. 'duet (w/ Prika)' exists because prika's S2 enforces a permanent Singing state, so that mode drops the gate and runs the Singing values unconditionally. A team pairing her with prika must SELECT the duet mode explicitly.
⚠ DUET ROTATION: in graded comps holding BOTH mint and prika, prika takes the FIRST burst and MINT TAKES EVERY BURST AFTER — driven from prika's side by her duet-mode burstFirst + burstCdr −9999. It requires the comp to select the duet modes on BOTH units. A harness that does not runs them solo and reports mint artificially COLD. If she ever reads far colder in one tool than another, CHECK MODE SELECTION FIRST.
⚑ OPEN (1) TEAMMATE-DAMAGE COVARIANCE: the alternating gate assumes teammates' damage is spread evenly across her Singing and Dancing windows. If it clusters toward or away from Singing (reload or cooldown alignment), the true board value differs. Solo mode currently has ZERO real-fight anchor — her only graded comp forces duet — so this is unanchored, not merely unmeasured. Estimate a few % at board level in a future solo-mint comp; recipe: a Mint-focus solo recording comparing Singing-window against Dancing-window team damage; tier 2.
FULL-CHARGE TRIGGER: 'Activates when attacking with Full Charge' is encoded on the fullCharge primitive (fires only on charged pulls); in-sim an RL (chargeFrames 60) releases exclusively at full charge, so the cadence is every pull — the always-full-charge fire model is an engine-wide premise (pinned by the trigger-kinds matrix), no longer a unit-local proxy. Every blind re-derivation shared that premise, so their agreement is convergent rather than independent evidence. No encoding change unless the engine's RL path can emit an uncharged or partial shot — verify that, and if it can, gate on the charged-shot event; tier 3.
NOT ENCODED, deliberately: S2's 'Cancels Assigned Part' block. This is an expressibility GAP — resourceGate reads a resource POOL, not a buff-active/absent state, so 'while NOT in Sing Along status' has no primitive. Omitting it is the safe direction: when Mint casts every rotation (20s cooldown) her Sing Along is live at every stage-3 entry and the cancel would never fire anyway, whereas encoding it unconditionally would strip her parts every rotation. The burst's 'gains Assigned Part' lines are the toggle's own bookkeeping, already expressed by the `singing` resource.

skill1: Full Charge in Assigned Part: Dancing: all allies recover 1.8% of caster's Max HP every 1 sec, lasts 3 sec. — magnitude only: the 3-tick recovery-event window is modeled (event-only heal, Dancing-gated via the singing resource, solo mode); the HP amount has no engine consumer (no HP pool)
skill2: Activates when entering Burst Stage 3 while not in Sing Along status: Cancels Singing and Dancing.
burst: Only one Assigned Part is applied according to Mint's current status.
Status 1: If in the Assigned Part: Dancing status, Mint gains Assigned Part: Singing. This effect is continuous and cannot be removed.
Status 2: If not in the Assigned Part: Dancing status, Mint gains Assigned Part: Dancing. This effect is continuous and cannot be removed.

caveats: burst: the three 'Assigned Part' status lines (Only one Assigned Part is applied…; Status 1 Dancing→Singing; Status 2 →Dancing) are the toggle's bookkeeping and carry no damage or buff of their own — they are EXPRESSED by the `singing` resource and its two everyN burstCast blocks, not dropped.

skill2: 'entering Burst Stage 3 while NOT in Sing Along status → Cancels Assigned Part' is deliberately NOT encoded — an expressibility gap, since resourceGate reads a resource pool rather than a buff-active/absent state. Safe direction: at her 20s cooldown Sing Along is live at every stage-3 entry, so the real cancel never fires, whereas an unconditional encoding would strip her parts every rotation.

skill1/skill2: the Singing-gated lines run at FULL kit-literal value on alternate rotations (resourceGate {singing min 1}), not at half value every rotation. ⚑ this assumes teammate damage is spread evenly across her Singing and Dancing windows; solo mode has no real-fight anchor, since her only graded comp forces 'duet (w/ Prika)'.

modes: 'solo' is the graded default. A comp pairing her with prika MUST explicitly select 'duet (w/ Prika)' on both units — otherwise both run solo, prika's burstFirst/lockout never fires, and mint reads artificially COLD. Check mode selection first if two tools disagree about her.

skill1: 'Activates when attacking with Full Charge' is encoded on the fullCharge trigger, which fires only on charged pulls — for an RL, every pull; the engine's charge path releases exclusively at full charge (⚑ tier 3 engine-wide premise — revisit if the engine's RL path can emit a partial shot).
